about: docs/PLAN-ZAGONETKE-IZ-PARTIJE.md, phase 3: the request the app sends to POST /review-words for one review, and a model's answer to it. The server's tests validate the request and the answer; the app's builder must produce the request from the review of the same game, word for word.

request.game: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bc4 Nf6 4. O-O Bc5

moments.label: 3. Bc4
moments.facts: With the best move, d4, White is slightly better; after Bc4, it is about even. 12 seconds left on White's clock; the move took 1 second.

slots.text: The game's move, Bc4. After it, it is about even.
The better line: d4 exd4 Nxd4. With it, White is slightly better. On the board after d4: The black pawn on e5 is attacked twice and defended only once. White's pawns hold more of the centre.
After Bc4, the refutation: Nf6 d3. On the board after Nf6: The white pawn on e4 is attacked by the black knight on f6 and has no defender.

moments.label: 4...Bc5
moments.facts: Only Bc5 held: with it, it is about even; with the next best, Be7, White is clearly better. 2 minutes 20 seconds left on Black's clock; the move took 12 seconds.

slots.text: The only move that held, Bc5, and the game found it. On the board after it: The black bishop on c5 pins the white pawn on f2 to the king on g1.
